---
title: "MediaPipe Face Landmarker in Quarto"
format: html
---

Questo esempio utilizza **MediaPipe** per rilevare i punti principali dell'espressione facciale.

::: {=html}
<div id="liveView" class="videoView" style="position: relative;">
  <button id="enableWebcamButton" class="btn btn-primary">Attendi...</button>
  <div style="position: relative; margin-top: 10px;">
  <video id="webcam" style="width: 100%; height: auto; display: block;" autoplay playsinline></video>
  <canvas id="output_canvas" style="position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none;"></canvas>
  </div>
  <div id="blendshapes" style="width: 300px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; height: 480px; overflow-y: auto; background: #f4f4f4; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px;">
    <p>Espressioni rilevate...</p>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="module">
import {
  FaceLandmarker,
  FilesetResolver,
  DrawingUtils
} from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.3";

// Spostiamo le dichiarazioni qui, ma le assegniamo dopo
let video;
let canvasElement;
let canvasCtx;
let faceLandmarker;
let runningMode = "VIDEO";

// Funzione per inizializzare gli elementi del DOM
function initElements() {
  video = document.getElementById("webcam");
  canvasElement = document.getElementById("output_canvas");
  
  if (!canvasElement) {
    console.error("Errore: canvas non trovato nel DOM!");
    return;
  }
  
  canvasCtx = canvasElement.getContext("2d");
}

// Inizializza tutto quando il DOM è pronto
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  initElements();
  createFaceLandmarker();
});

// 1. Inizializza il Face Landmarker
async function createFaceLandmarker() {
  const filesetResolver = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(
    "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.3/wasm"
  );
  faceLandmarker = await FaceLandmarker.createFromOptions(filesetResolver, {
    baseOptions: {
      modelAssetPath: `https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task`,
      delegate: "GPU"
    },
    outputFaceBlendshapes: true,
    runningMode,
    numFaces: 1
  });
  enableWebcamButton.innerText = "ATTIVA WEBCAM";
}
createFaceLandmarker();

// 2. Gestione Webcam
enableWebcamButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!faceLandmarker) return;
  
  const constraints = { video: true };
  video.srcObject = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);
  video.addEventListener("loadeddata", predictWebcam);
  enableWebcamButton.style.display = "none";
});

// 3. Loop di rilevamento e disegno
async function predictWebcam() {
  // Adatta il canvas alle dimensioni del video
  canvasElement.width = video.videoWidth;
  canvasElement.height = video.videoHeight;

  let startTimeMs = performance.now();
  const results = faceLandmarker.detectForVideo(video, startTimeMs);

  canvasCtx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasElement.width, canvasElement.height);
  
  if (results.faceLandmarks) {
    const drawingUtils = new DrawingUtils(canvasCtx);
    for (const landmarks of results.faceLandmarks) {
      // Disegna i connettori sottili per il viso
      drawingUtils.drawConnectors(
        landmarks,
        FaceLandmarker.FACE_LANDMARKS_TESSELATION,
        { color: "#C0C0C070", lineWidth: 1 }
      );
      // Disegna i contorni di occhi, labbra e sopracciglia
      drawingUtils.drawConnectors(
        landmarks,
        FaceLandmarker.FACE_LANDMARKS_RIGHT_EYE,
        { color: "#FF3030" }
      );
      drawingUtils.drawConnectors(
        landmarks,
        FaceLandmarker.FACE_LANDMARKS_LEFT_EYE,
        { color: "#30FF30" }
      );
      drawingUtils.drawConnectors(
        landmarks,
        FaceLandmarker.FACE_LANDMARKS_FACE_OVAL,
        { color: "#E0E0E0" }
      );
    }
  }
  //Parte nuova
  const blendshapesContainer = document.getElementById("blendshapes");

  if (results.faceBlendshapes && results.faceBlendshapes.length > 0) {
    let htmlContent = "<ul>";
  
    // Prendiamo le blendshapes del primo viso rilevato
    const shapes = results.faceBlendshapes[0].categories;
    shapes.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, 10)
    shapes.forEach((shape) => {
      // Creiamo una piccola barra visiva per ogni valore
      const width = (shape.score * 100).toFixed(0);
      htmlContent += `
        <li style="list-style: none; margin-bottom: 5px;">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between;">
            <span>${shape.categoryName}</span>
            <span>${shape.score.toFixed(2)}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="background: #ddd; width: 100%; height: 5px;">
            <div style="background: #007bff; width: ${width}%; height: 100%;"></div>
          </div>
        </li>`;
    });
  
    htmlContent += "</ul>";
    blendshapesContainer.innerHTML = htmlContent;
  }
  window.requestAnimationFrame(predictWebcam);
}
</script>

<style>
  video { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
  canvas { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
</style>
:::
